meta.title: Register your institution
meta.description: Register your school, college or university to take part in Friends of Animals competitions.

register.title: Register your institution
register.lead: Tell us about your school, college or university. FOA checks every registration, usually with the principal, before your institution can enter competitions.

pinCode.label: PIN code
pinCode.error: Enter a six-digit PIN code that doesn't start with 0.

contactEmail.label: Office email
contactEmail.error: Enter an email address like office@school.in.

principalEmail.label: Principal's email
principalEmail.hint: FOA may write to the principal to confirm the registration.
principalEmail.error: Enter an email address like principal@school.in.

principalPhone.label: Principal's mobile number
principalPhone.hint: An Indian mobile number, 10 digits. Stored encrypted.

expectedParticipants.label: How many students may take part
expectedParticipants.hint: Your best guess. You can change your plans later.
expectedParticipants.error: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,00,000.

alerts.invalid_input: Some answers need fixing. Each one says what to change.
alerts.already_registered: You have already registered an institution. You can see it on your institution page.
alerts.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a few minutes.

meta.title: Your institution
meta.description: Your institution's registration with Friends of Animals.

mine.title: Your institution
mine.lead: See whether FOA has checked your registration, and your Institution ID once it has.
mine.registered: Thank you. FOA has your registration and will check it soon. We'll send you a message when it's done.

none.title: You haven't registered an institution
none.body: Register your school, college or university to take part in FOA competitions.

mine.institutionIdHint: Use this ID when you talk to FOA about your institution.

explain.pending_verification: FOA is checking your registration. This usually takes a few working days.
explain.verified: Your institution is verified. You are its admin.
explain.rejected: FOA couldn't accept this registration. You can register again with corrected details.
explain.suspended: Your institution is suspended for now. Contact FOA to find out what happens next.
